title: Hearty Turkish Lamb Wrap
description: A malty, creamy and festive Turkish lamb kofté rolled in fresh pandan leaves, garnished with morning-glory pak bung and sun-dried tomato confit.

ingredients.name: coconut yogurt
ingredients.notes: use dairy yogurt for richer flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground lamb, diced onion, minced garlic, smoked paprika, dried mint, salt, pepper, and chickpea flour until well mixed.
Fold in coconut yogurt until the mixture is moist and holds together; rest for 10 minutes.
Heat a grill pan over medium heat and shape the mixture into small oval koftés, about 3 cm long.
Cook the koftés for 3–4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through, turning occasionally.
While the koftés are cooking, warm the pandan leaves in a dry skillet for 1 minute to make them pliable.
Once cooked, set the koftés aside and lightly drizzle them with a little olive oil.
Place a kofté on each pandan leaf, top with a slice of confit tomato, a handful of morning‑glory pak bung leaves, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Fold the sides of the pandan leaf over the filling and roll tightly to form a wrap.
Arrange the wraps on a plate, drizzle with extra coconut yogurt, and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
